text:
Olivia R: Hey team — received invoice HLO-5521 from Halo Labs for $14,200 but our OCR didn't find any PO. Vendor only included PO as 'Ref: PO-22011' in their outgoing email body, not in the PDF. Attaching email and PDF.

Mark C: Can you paste the invoice number and vendor ref? I'll try a manual match in ProcureLink.

Olivia R: Invoice HLO-5521, vendor ref HAL-77B, suggested PO PO-22011. Attachment: halo_hlo_5521.pdf + vendor_email.txt

finance-bot: Automated note: incoming invoice HLO-5521 flagged as "no_po_detected". No auto-match. Suggested actions: 1) ask vendor to reissue PDF with PO in text, 2) accept signed vendor email + approver confirmation for manual match, or 3) AP manual override.

vendor-halo-billing: Hi Olivia — sorry about that. We can reissue HLO-5521 as HLO-5521-R1 with PO-22011 in text, or we can provide a signed statement linking the invoice to PO-22011. Which do you prefer?

Elsa K: PO-22011 is in my domain (Security). I can approve the manual match if vendor provides the email string confirming the PO and I sign off in ProcureLink. Prefer vendor reissue for clean audit though.

Mark C: I'll try a manual attach first. Steps I run: ```ProcureLink -> Search PO PO-22011 -> Open -> Attach invoice -> upload halo_hlo_5521.pdf -> Save -> Mark as manual_match.``` System accepted the file but PO field remains empty because PDF doesn't contain the text. Invoice set to manual_review.

AP Queue: AP note: HLO-5521 set to manual_review and assigned to queue ap-manual-matches. Policy: require either vendor reissued PDF or vendor email + approver attestation. If approver (Elsa K) confirms in-thread we can proceed with manual match.

Elsa K: Confirming here: I verify that HLO-5521 relates to PO-22011 and I approve the charge to GL 5803-SecOps, CC-122. Approving manual match. :white_check_mark:

vendor-halo-billing: Uploading reissued PDF now: https://files.halolabs.example/HLO-5521-R1.pdf — it contains PO-22011 as plain text and line-level detail. Keeping original invoice number with R1 suffix.

finance-bot: File received. OCR matched PO-22011. Suggested auto-link to PO-22011.

Mark C: Per AP, I swapped the manual record to an auto-match after the reissue and finalized attachment. Payment route: awaiting Elsa approval (recorded). Completed ProcureLink note: "Vendor reissued HLO-5521-R1; PO-22011 matched; approver Elsa K."

Olivia R: Great — thanks everyone. Closing ticket after payment processes.

finance-bot: Thread closed: HLO-5521 resolved. Audit trail: files stored under invoices/halo/2026/HLO-5521-R1.pdf and vendor emails folder.
